fiction_notice: Original fiction. Not a real event, person, company or recording.

hooks.text: The 1998 tape has a flat screen in it.
hooks.note: Nine words. The anachronism does all the work and needs no explaining.

hooks.text: There is a television in the old tape that did not exist yet.
hooks.note: Clearer but longer, and the phrase 'did not exist yet' explains the joke.

hooks.text: Something in the corner of the old tape is showing today.
hooks.note: Atmospheric, but 'today' is vague until the reveal.

hook_rationale: Hook 1 trusts the audience. Anyone who has seen a 1998 living room knows a flat screen does not belong in one, so the viewer catches the anomaly themselves in under two seconds, which is far stronger than being told about it.
final_twist: The screen in 1998 is showing the room where the tape is being watched, which means the party was looking at the viewer twenty-eight years before he sat down.
music_mood: Warm nostalgic tape-saturated pad for the first fifteen seconds that curdles into a single held dissonance once the zoom begins. No music at all from 0:36, so the last eleven seconds are lamp buzz and tape noise.
sound_bed: Camcorder warble, tape dropouts, capture-deck mechanism, anglepoise buzz, and one abrupt removal of all party sound.
